_meta.purpose: Parity-test fixture for the multi-format scoring refactor.
_meta.source: Pulled live from https://tnt-golf-league.pplx.app via API as admin on 2026-05-07T18:50:06.342973+00:00

sanitization.players: Included; players table has no PII fields (firstName, lastName only)

schema_notes: team_scores is the ACTIVE scoring table (per team, per hole).
scores is the LEGACY per-player table — still populated but not the system of record.
matchups stores the COMPUTED teamAPoints/teamBPoints — these are what the parity test must reproduce.
Each course has 9 holes (this league plays 9-hole rounds, alternating front/back).
team_handicap_history rows are written by the scoring engine after a week is finalized.
parity_test_recipe: 1. Seed an in-memory SQLite (or fresh data.db) from the tables below.
2. For each played matchup, call the OLD computeMatchup(teamA, teamB, holes, cfg).
3. Call the NEW scorers['team_match_play'].compute({...}) with equivalent inputs.
4. Assert byte-equal: teamAPoints, teamBPoints, per-hole aPoints/bPoints, strokesReceivedByA/B.
5. Test fails if any matchup diverges by even 0.5 points.
